## Summary
Revenue columns in `order_details` have been reporting 0.00 since 2026-08-04 due to an upstream ETL migration bug, causing executive revenue dashboards to flatline. Row counts remained normal, preventing automated volume alerts from triggering.

## Blast Radius (downstream)
- `ORDER_DETAILS` (Dataset) — owner: DataHub SE Team, David Kim, Julia Novak
- `order_details` (Dataset) — owner: EMP006, ORG_DATA_PLATFORM, Julia Novak
- `ORDER_DETAILS_REPLICA` (Dataset) — owner: DataHub SE Team, David Kim, Julia Novak
- `order_details` (Dataset) — owner: EMP006, ORG_DATA_PLATFORM
- `Order Entry Dashboard` (Dashboard) — owner: Alexander Wright, Samantha Taylor, Michael Scott, Patrick O'Brien
- `order_entries_dashboard` (Container) — owner: Alexander Wright, Samantha Taylor, Michael Scott, Patrick O'Brien
- `order_details` (Dataset) — owner: EMP006, ORG_DATA_PLATFORM
- `ORDER_DETAILS` (Dataset) — owner: Alexander Wright, Samantha Taylor, Michael Scott, Patrick O'Brien
- `order_details` (Dataset) — owner: EMP006, ORG_DATA_PLATFORM
- `Order Details` (Dataset) — owner: Alexander Wright, Samantha Taylor, Michael Scott, Patrick O'Brien

## Likely Root Cause (upstream)
Trace back from `order_details` toward the origin. The upstream asset responsible is `ORDER_ITEMS` (`urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:snowflake,b2fd91.order_entry_db.order_entry.order_items,PROD)`), connected via direct lineage where `order_details` computes revenue columns from `order_items.unit_price`.

Evidence quoted directly from `ORDER_ITEMS` description:
"UPSTREAM CHANGE 2026-08-04: the nightly ETL was migrated to a new extractor. `unit_price` is now written as NULL for all rows loaded after 02:00 UTC; `quantity` is unaffected. Source system still has the values. Not yet backfilled."

## Recommended Actions
1. Fix the new nightly ETL extractor so that `unit_price` is correctly populated instead of NULL.
2. Run a backfill for `ORDER_ITEMS` for data loaded since 2026-08-04 02:00 UTC using values from the source system.
3. Refresh downstream models (`order_details` and replicas) once `ORDER_ITEMS` is corrected and backfilled.
4. Implement data quality assertions/alerts on monetary/revenue columns to detect null/zero values even when row counts are normal.
